correctness.rationale: Exact piecewise linear one-pulse convolution R and its translate determine each superlevel interval under W>=2d. At g=W-q equality plateaus are included, yielding a right-hand jump q for 0<q<=d or 2d-q for d<q<2d. Two analytic cases cover g=0, equality q=d and all positive gaps. An independent Fraction-based partition/interpolation checker passes 6451 finite rational cases; numerical tests are supporting evidence, not a proof.

value.rationale: For the natural two-heatwave test case of an 84-day rolling thermal metric, the theorem completely classifies the time spent above a threshold and the number of episodes. Its shared critical clean gap, opposite slopes and positive right-hand jumps expose a precise temporal-aggregation artifact that matters when interpreting heat-stress durations; the 4/8-degree-week calculation supplies a reproducible benchmark. The claim is restricted to this diagnostic, not a biological prediction, and its structural classification is materially more informative than a one-pulse boxcar response.
